contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals and enterprises seeking high-quality visual content creation using generative AI

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-screen split hero with brand/logo area, large left-aligned headline stack, short support copy, and a compact bullet list of key value points. Strong top-to-bottom hierarchy, minimal visual clutter, and prominent white-on-dark contrast.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Lead with a high-impact hero, then move into a form/lead-capture block, followed by stacked feature/product sections with repeated headline-description-feature grouping. Rhythm favors simple vertical flow over complex interleaving.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Compact utility cards with light borders or subtle dividers, modest rounding, restrained shadows, and dense information layout. Cards are functional rather than decorative, with icon support only when needed.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA appears in the hero and is repeated per major product section. CTA styling is direct and conversion-oriented, with a secondary emphasis on lead capture rather than multiple competing actions.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module present; the layout supports inquiry-first conversion instead of self-serve pricing comparison.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the provided reference; likely minimal or standard utility footer outside the extracted pattern.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Light media usage with logo placement in hero and optional icon-led list items. No large editorial imagery; content density is prioritized over visual storytelling.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Repeating feature blocks with a section label, product name, headline, short description, then a multi-point capability list. Each block supports scannability through consistent heading hierarchy and grouped subfeatures.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form section placed immediately after the hero. Uses a card container, clear heading, and hidden tracking fields, implying a conversion-focused capture flow with minimal front-end friction.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation with no evident animated storytelling patterns. Any motion is likely limited to standard page-level or form behaviors.
designNotes: Overall style is B2B enterprise and conversion-first.
Hierarchy relies on typography and spacing more than imagery.
Content is organized for fast scanning and lead generation.
Feature sections repeat a stable template for reuse across products.
Visual treatment favors dark hero contrast and clean informational blocks.

personality.buyer: Professionals and enterprises seeking high-quality visual content creation
personality.reasoning: The product is clearly generative AI, but the brief requires a fresh direction and explicitly forbids repeating the recently used cinematic-ai family. To keep the page distinct while still feeling advanced and trustworthy for enterprise buyers, I chose an operational-dashboard approach with orange-led brand cues from Techjockey’s brand palette. This keeps the experience grounded, product-led, and premium without drifting into the default purple AI look. The layout should feel like an intelligent studio control room: structured, high-signal, interactive, and designed to showcase both image and video generation capabilities with clarity.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and needs a smaller hero size to preserve hierarchy and avoid awkward wrapping while still feeling premium.

colours.colourReason: The brand palette is used exactly as provided: orange as the primary hero and CTA color, supported by white, charcoal, and soft grey for contrast. This creates a strong Techjockey identity while keeping the page visually distinct from other AI pages.

layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a strong visual showcase, so the hero should split text and media instead of centering. Using the brand orange as the hero background gives immediate identity and satisfies the brand rule.
layout.featureReason: Alternating full-width sections with split panels and comparison blocks creates a fresh structure distinct from the previously used spotlight-plus-grid pattern, while helping separate Seedream image generation and Seedance video generation clearly.
layout.darkSectionFor: Video generation and enterprise infrastructure proof sections

personality.imageryDirection: Use layered product-style visuals rather than lifestyle photography: abstract AI workflow shells, prompt-to-output panels, timeline strips, audio waveform overlays, and floating metric chips. For the hero, show a polished split visual with an image-generation canvas on one side and a cinematic video frame plus waveform on the other. Keep visuals crisp, technical, and enterprise-grade, with subtle glow from orange highlights and clean UI depth.
personality.designPersonality: An intelligent AI production suite for enterprise buyers: structured like a control center, visually confident, orange-led, and highly legible. It should feel like premium software for teams that care about precision, control, and output quality, with strong contrast, dashboard-style composition, and restrained but sophisticated motion.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Text-led hero with strong left hierarchy and compact value bullets
componentNeeds.notes: Use a dark, authoritative background with white text. Keep the headline large but controlled due to long copy. Show only one primary CTA if no secondary CTA exists. Include compact bullets or short value points for immediate scanning.
Use for the supporting line and extras such as multimodal creation and enterprise-ready infrastructure. Keep it minimal and conversion-focused.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Section header + descriptive intro + dense utility feature grid
componentNeeds.notes: Present as a structured product block with a strong headline, short description, then feature cards or stacked feature rows. Prefer 2-column layout if space allows, otherwise single-column on mobile.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Compact white cards with subtle border and no icon requirement
componentNeeds.notes: Use the main capabilities as scan-friendly cards. Prioritize text alignment, high-resolution output, typographic rendering, multi-image composition, and structural fidelity.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Secondary product block with same pattern for consistency
componentNeeds.notes: Mirror the Seedream section to reinforce design system consistency. Highlight audio-visual sync, text-to-video, lip-sync, camera control, and speed.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Dense capability cards or list rows
componentNeeds.notes: Keep the video model section visually aligned with the image model section, but allow slightly more emphasis on motion and cinematic language in the copy hierarchy.
Because the content includes pricing, use clear plan cards with included features. Keep the quote CTA prominent. Preserve enterprise inquiry behavior rather than self-serve checkout.
Use role-based testimonials with prominent quote styling. Emphasize creative director, video producer, and art director perspectives to match buyer evaluation criteria.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a single-screen, high-contrast hero with a strong left-aligned headline stack and compact support copy. Keep the CTA highly visible and avoid visual noise. Because no form is provided, the hero should act as the main conversion driver.
layoutStrategy.features: Stack the two product sections vertically with repeated section headers and dense capability lists. Use consistent card rhythm, restrained spacing, and clear hierarchy to support long-form scanning.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place testimonials after pricing to reinforce confidence after commercial review. Use light contrast background and role-specific quotes for credibility.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Show enterprise-oriented pricing cards as inquiry prompts rather than checkout units. Make the pricing section visually distinct with a lighter background and clear include lists.
layoutStrategy.form: No form should be designed because the input does not provide one. Keep conversion through CTAs only, with quote/demo-style actions.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Default Techjockey enterprise AI profile: Plus Jakarta Sans headings with Inter body; dark trust-authority hero palette; accent-led CTA; white feature cards with subtle borders; moderate spacing; subtle motion only.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a conversion-first single-product landing page for ByteDance Generative Models with a dark, authoritative hero, followed by two tightly structured product sections for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, then pricing cards and testimonial proof. Keep the layout vertical, enterprise-friendly, and highly scannable. Use restrained visual language, clear hierarchy, and reusable card patterns. No form module is needed; the page should drive quote/demo intent through CTAs and product clarity.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: default + learning-friendly hybrid; use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body, with deep blue/purple-leaning brand treatment and strong conversion CTA contrast

sections.variantHint: dark hero, split hero layout with text left and compact value list; no secondary CTA text button because input is empty
sections.notes: Build as a strong top-fold conversion frame with dark primary background, white text, and right-side compact brand/media area. Since no explicit media asset is provided, use a restrained product/logo placeholder zone with simple brand mark treatment rather than editorial imagery. Keep headline stack, support copy, and bullet list tightly grouped. Primary CTA should be prominent and repeated later in product sections.

sections.variantHint: light grey band with compact stat chips and utility trust messaging; no badges/customer counts provided, so use extra supporting claims only from extras
sections.notes: Convert the provided banner feature line into a short horizontal utility strip under the hero to reinforce product breadth without inventing trust badges or customer counts. Use compact chip-like text items separated by dividers. Avoid adding fake logos or metrics. Keep this section visually lighter than the hero and minimal in height.

sections.variantHint: feature section with intro block followed by 2-column feature card grid; include CTA at section end
sections.notes: Use a section label, product name, headline, description, then a structured capability grid. Seedream has 6 feature items total, so use a 3-column grid for the feature cards on desktop, while the opening capability summary can span full width above them. Preserve the inquiry-first CTA as Request Demo. Use standard feature cards with 1px border, 12px radius, and dense content layout. Do not over-decorate.

sections.variantHint: feature section with intro block followed by 3-column capability cards; no CTA provided in source
sections.notes: Mirror the Seedream section rhythm for consistency. Include section label, product name, headline, and description. Since there is no CTA in source, keep the section purely informational and avoid inventing a button. With 6 feature items, use a 3-column grid on desktop. Keep cards compact and functional; use icon support only if a simple system icon is needed, not placeholders.

sections.variantHint: two-card inquiry pricing module; centered section header above cards; left card without numeric price and right card with starting monthly price
sections.notes: Render as a light grey section with two elevated cards. Use quote-style pricing instead of a direct checkout flow. The Seedream plan has no visible price, so present it as inquiry-based with includes and Get Quote CTA. The Seedance plan must show Starting at $1,000/month/ and all required pricing anatomy: includes list, CTA, and pricing emphasis. Keep the layout centered and balanced. Include trust line only if the design system allows within the pricing card body.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with accent left border and star row; italic quote body
sections.notes: Use three testimonial cards in a 3-column grid. Each card should include gold star rating row, italicized quote, bold author, and muted designation/company line. Keep card width consistent and avoid inventing company names where missing. The testimonial content should feel enterprise-relevant and support confidence in both image and video models.

sections.variantHint: centered compact inquiry frame using only the provided headline/fields/CTA, but source is empty so use minimal CTA-led contact prompt derived from product conversion intent
sections.notes: The provided form object is empty, so do not fabricate full form fields. If a form container is required for execution, keep it as a placeholder lead-capture frame with a simple CTA area only if product flow demands it; otherwise, omit interactive field components in Figma and mark this as a reserved conversion slot. Because the input says hero CTA and pricing CTAs already support conversion, this section should remain minimal.

sections.variantHint: not supported by content; omit from active build
sections.notes: No news items were supplied. Do not create a visible news row. Keep this as a non-rendered placeholder only if the page template requires optional slots.

sections.variantHint: dark stacked hero; text first or compact media-less hero if product visual is unavailable
sections.notes: Stack all hero content vertically with the same content hierarchy as desktop. Reduce headline scale for mobile and keep CTA full-width. If no media asset is present, use a text-only hero with compact feature bullets below the support line. Preserve strong contrast and avoid introducing secondary CTA elements.

sections.variantHint: compact stacked chips with dividers; single-column wrapping
sections.notes: Compress the post-hero support strip into a wrapped vertical/stacked utility area. Keep it short and scannable. Avoid adding badges or metrics not present in input.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards with section intro and CTA at bottom
sections.notes: Translate the desktop product block to a single-column mobile stack. Keep intro text first, then feature cards one per row. Use a full-width Request Demo CTA at the end. Preserve content order for scannability and minimize card padding relative to desktop while keeping the standard design-system card treatment.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards, no CTA provided
sections.notes: Use the same mobile rhythm as Seedream for familiarity. Present one feature card per row. Keep the section dense but readable. No CTA is added because source has none.

sections.variantHint: two stacked quote cards with full-width CTAs
sections.notes: Stack both pricing cards vertically, one after the other, with the Seedance price displayed prominently and Seedream treated as quote-based. Ensure CTA buttons are full width. Maintain the checklist list and section separation for clarity. Do not invent EMI or payment options not provided.

sections.variantHint: single-column testimonial cards with optional horizontal swipe behavior in prototype only
sections.notes: Show testimonials as a single-column stack. Keep star row, italic quote, author, and designation all visible within each card. Avoid carousel complexity in the build plan; if needed, note swipe as prototype behavior only.

sections.variantHint: reserved conversion slot; no explicit fields in source
sections.notes: Keep as a minimal placeholder or omit if the mobile page needs tighter length. Do not fabricate fields. If included, maintain simple centered block with no interactive complexity.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body text across the page to align with default Techjockey typography for unknown categories.
Apply a dark, high-contrast hero treatment with accent CTA buttons; keep section rhythm vertical and conversion-focused.
Do not invent content for empty inputs: secondary hero CTA, trust badges, customer count, form fields, why Techjockey, and news should remain absent or placeholder-only.
Seedream should use a 3-column feature card grid on desktop and single-column cards on mobile; Seedance should mirror the structure for consistency.
Pricing is inquiry-first: one quote-based plan and one starting-price plan, both with full include lists and Get Quote CTAs.
Maintain compact, utility-driven card styling with light borders, modest rounding, and restrained elevation; avoid decorative imagery-heavy treatment.
For mobile, stack all sections vertically with full-width CTAs and one-card-per-row feature/testimonial presentation.
Keep frame heights as estimates; final Figma implementation should auto-size based on content while preserving the proposed section order.
